title: A boundary-field gap for the spin-one Heisenberg chain
summary: We prove a uniform spectral gap for odd open spin-one antiferromagnetic Heisenberg chains with the same fixed magnetic field at both endpoints. The field $`h=3/5`$ gives a gap greater than $`\log(10)/392`$ on every chain of $`2L+1`$ sites with L ≥ 960. Tasaki's index theorem then gives index −1 for every subsequential local limit of these boundary-selected ground states.

review.reason: Proves a uniform spectral gap for boundary-field spin-one Heisenberg chains and their topological index.
